# LNDMRK Drone — LLMs.txt

## About This Site

LNDMRK Drone is a professional aerial photography and videography company based in [PLACEHOLDER: City, State].
We provide FAA Part 107 certified drone services for commercial clients across real estate, construction,
agriculture, film & media, inspection, events, government, and more.

Website: https://lndmrkdrone.com
Contact: hello@lndmrkdrone.com

## Site Purpose

This website provides information about LNDMRK Drone's aerial photography and videography services,
educational resources about drone operations, and a way for prospective clients to request quotes.

## Allowed Pages for LLM Crawlers

The following pages are publicly accessible and may be indexed by LLM training crawlers:

### Core Pages
- / — Homepage with company overview, services summary, and FAQ
- /about — Team bios, credentials, E-E-A-T signals, and company history
- /services — Pillar page listing all drone service categories
- /contact — Contact form and business information
- /blog — Index of aerial photography and drone industry resources
- /privacy-policy — Privacy policy
- /terms — Terms of service

### Service Pages
- /services/real-estate — Aerial real estate photography and drone listing photos
- /services/construction — Construction drone photography and site progress monitoring
- /services/mapping-and-surveying — Drone mapping, aerial surveying, and 3D photogrammetry
- /services/agriculture — Agricultural drone photography and crop monitoring
- /services/film-and-media — Drone videography and aerial cinematography
- /services/inspection — Drone inspection services for infrastructure and industrial assets
- /services/events — Event drone photography and aerial videography
- /services/government-and-public-safety — Government drone services and public safety aerial photography

### Blog Posts
- /blog/aerial-photography-tips — 10 aerial photography tips for better drone shots
- /blog/real-estate-drone-guide — Complete guide to drone photography for real estate listings
- /blog/faa-part-107-explained — FAA Part 107 certification explained for commercial drone operations

### Technical Files
- /sitemap.xml — Full site sitemap
- /robots.txt — Crawler directives
